title: With Trump’s Hamas Deal in Peril, Kushner Set to Visit Israel for Gaza Talks
summary_full: Jared Kushner, President Trump’s senior aide, is expected to meet with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel, who has rejected a U.S.-backed deal to disarm Hamas.
